# ↩️ Rollback Checklist

## Trigger
Describe the regression and impact.

## Target
- Current commit:
- Last known-good commit:
- Affected files:

## Procedure
- [ ] Review commit diff.
- [ ] Choose revert or path restoration.
- [ ] Avoid overwriting unrelated changes.
- [ ] Run structural validation.
- [ ] Open affected pages in browser.
- [ ] Verify assets and documentation links.
- [ ] Publish rollback commit.

## Communication
Record the issue, action, and remaining limitations.
